grade_reason: The agent shows a mixed record with several profitable take-profit exits on ETH and SOL, but is heavily penalized by stop-losses on NVDA, BTC, and SOL, resulting in a net loss and a win rate below 50% on most major symbols.
winning_patterns: Take-profit exits on ETH/USDT and SOL/USDT during strong upward momentum phases yield significant gains (e.g., ETH +$332, SOL +$271).
Manual ADIR (Adaptive Directional) entries on APT/USDT and SOL/USDT successfully captured early trend moves before stop-losses were triggered.
Trailing-stop exits on ETH/USDT allowed partial profit realization while avoiding deep drawdowns during volatile swings.
failure_patterns: Stop-loss exits on NVDA and BTC/USDT during choppy or downward regimes caused repeated small losses that erode capital without clear directional bias.
Manual [GATE-SKIPPED] entries on AAPL, BTC, and TSLA resulted in immediate stop-losses or negligible moves, indicating poor entry timing or lack of volatility filter.
Overlapping NVDA trades (10 trades) show a pattern of entering too frequently in a ranging market, leading to a 40% win rate and cumulative loss.
position_sizing_rationale: The agent is taking too many overlapping positions on NVDA and BTC, which dilutes capital and increases exposure to regime noise; reducing size will lower the probability of consecutive stop-loss hits.
retrain_focus: Curate examples of successful take-profit exits on ETH/SOL and ADIR entries on APT/SOL, while excluding all [GATE-SKIPPED] trades and NVDA stop-loss clusters to teach the agent to filter choppy regimes and respect trailing-stop logic.
data_curation_advice: Include only trades with exit=take-profit or exit=manual_ADIR where pnl>0. Exclude all trades with exit=stop-loss on NVDA, BTC, and TSLA, and exclude any manual_[GATE-SKIPPED] entries regardless of pnl.
